You can authenticate these queries without storing shared access signature (SAS) tokens or relying on a shared server-level identity.

items.desc:
Expense Agent now supports creating expenses from imported credit card transaction feeds or automatically reconcile with them if the expense was created earlier. Key capabilities include:
Import credit card transaction data and review it in the web and mobile apps.
Automatically create expenses from imported card transactions.
Match imported transactions to existing expenses, where applicable.
Reduce duplicate data entry by leveraging transaction details already captured from credit card feeds.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Shared analytics foundation for historical reporting
items.desc: Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides out-of-the-box historical reporting built on a shared analytics foundation: a scalable, open, and AI-ready data foundation for Customer Experience and AI analytics scenarios across Dynamics 365. It uses a lakehouse-based architecture that can scale with data volume, supports curated analytics datasets for direct querying, and enables consistent reporting and semantic definitions across reports, agents, and copilots.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Network analytics enhancements
items.desc:
Network analytics updates are rolling out in Microsoft Viva Engage, giving corporate communicators and network admins more flexibility to analyze activity and engagement across their organization.
With this update, network analytics includes custom date ranges, faster activity data refreshes, updated dashboard and metric table designs, expanded organizational filters with search, and new people-manager filters for viewing direct reports or full reporting hierarchies. These enhancements make it easier to explore trends, understand audience engagement, and measure communications impact across the network.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Copilot studio cost controls in MAC
items.desc:
We’re expanding cost management for Microsoft Copilot Studio into the Microsoft 365 admin center. This gives administrators a more centralized way to manage Copilot Credit spend across usage-based AI workloads while retaining Copilot Studio cost management capabilities in the Power Platform admin center.
With this update, administrators can bring supported Copilot Studio environments and agents under Cost Management spending policies. Resource-based policies for environments and agents are the first planned scopes, with broader user and group policy support planned for a later phase.
Furthermore, this update will introduce cost data into…

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Enhance positive pay file generation through batch processing
items.desc: This feature improves the scalability and performance of positive pay file generation by enabling the process to run as a background batch job. Organizations that generate large positive pay files can now offload processing from the interactive user session, reducing the risk of timeouts and improving the overall user experience. The enhancement is designed to support high-volume check payment scenarios while maintaining the existing positive pay functionality and output formats.

items.title: Generally Available: Large OS Disk Encryption for Azure Confidential VM migrations
items.desc: Large OS Disk Encryption (LOSDE) is now generally available for Azure Confidential VM migration scenarios. Organizations can move larger, production-scale workloads into confidential computing with the OS disk fully protected, instead of being held back by disk size.During migration, the OS disk is encrypted with confidential disk encryption. This protects all critical partitions and binds the encryption keys to the VM's virtual TPM, so disk content is accessible only to that VM, not to the host or hypervisor. Keys are released only after the platform passes attestation. Because encryption happens as part of the move, teams don't have to…

availability of the HTTP DDoS ruleset for Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF)
on Azure Front Door Premium. HTTP-layer DDoS attacks remain a leading cause of
application downtime, and static controls such as IP filters and fixed rate

provides automated, adaptive layer 7 protection that learns, detects, and
defends with minimal configuration. Once assigned, it continuously baselines

items.title: Generally Available: Azure MCP Server 3.0
items.desc:
Azure MCP Server 3.0 is now generally available, expanding how AI agents and developer tools interact with Azure through the open Model Context Protocol (MCP).
This release introduces new and expanded capabilities:Infrastructure as code: Azure Terraform tools for provider documentation, Azure Verified Modules, resource export, and policy validation.
Protection and recovery: Azure Backup and Azure Resilience Management tools for backup protection, recovery plans, readiness checks, and drills.
Cost optimization: Expanded Azure Advisor capabilities and optimization tools for reviewing recommendations, comparing resource options, and…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Decline a call with a message on Mobile
items.desc: Users can quickly decline an incoming Teams call and send a predefined message to the caller at the same time. From the incoming call screen, users can select a message such as letting the caller know they're unavailable or will call back, providing helpful context without having to answer the call or separately open a chat.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
items.desc: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Start side conversations during meetings
items.desc: Keep collaboration moving without disrupting the main discussion. Start and continue one-to-one or small-group conversations directly from a meeting to ask questions, coordinate next steps, share information, and collaborate in parallel while staying engaged in the conversation, reducing context switching and helping teams stay focused and productive.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Two presenters can share their screens or windows simultaneously in meetings
items.desc: Two presenters can share a screen or window at the same time in a Teams meeting. Participants can see both shared content streams simultaneously, making it easier to compare and discuss content from different presenters.

items.title: Outlook: All Day events to show up more clearly in the Mail module Calendar Preview
items.desc: We're making it easier to tell when receiving meeting invites that conflict with scheduled Out of Office time or Busy All Day events, on Outlook Web and Outlook for Windows.

items.title: Outlook: Sort improvements to the message list
items.desc: When sorting on Outlook for Web or Outlook for Windows, if the Sort By field is not one of From, Subject, or Date Received, we will now show an additional column for the Sort By value (e.g., Size). We will also support sorting by Flag Due Date.

items.title: Outlook: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
items.desc: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes. Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place. Users can read, delete, move, archive, and mark messages across accounts without switching between mailboxes. The experience integrates with Copilot for AI-assisted email workflows and supports Immersive Search for finding messages across your primary account. Advanced scenarios such as cross-account search and shared mailbox support will follow in later releases.

items.title: Outlook: Variable number of message preview lines
items.desc: Outlook for Windows and Outlook for Web will now allow users to modify how the preview text for emails show in the message list. The preview text can now take up 2 lines, 1 whole line, or 0 additional lines.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.desc: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
items.desc: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing. New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Scanner data export for custom reporting
items.desc: Learn about the state of your scanned repositories and create custom reports with the information protection scanner. Labeling, classification and protection actions on scanned files are stored in SQL tables that form a foundation to feed into custom reports.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: December CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent mobile app
items.desc:
The Expense Agent mobile app for Dynamics 365 Business Central extends expense capture to iOS and Android mobile devices by enabling employees to submit receipts directly from their phone or using native share functionality.
Employees can take a photo of a receipt with their phone camera or select an existing image or document, and share it with Expense Agent mobile app. They can also capture multiple receipts directly from the mobile app and process them automatically. The Expense Agent mobile app processes the input, extracts relevant information, and automatically creates expense entries without requiring additional manual steps.
The…

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Shared analytics for historical reporting
items.desc: Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides out-of-the-box historical reporting built on a shared analytics foundation: a scalable, open, and AI-ready data foundation for Customer Experience and AI analytics scenarios across Dynamics 365. It uses a lakehouse-based architecture that can scale with data volume, supports curated analytics datasets for direct querying, and enables consistent reporting and semantic definitions across reports, agents, and copilots.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Historical analytics
items.desc: Contact Center historical analytics provides out-of-box historical reporting for Dynamics 365 Contact Center, built on a shared analytics foundation. It moves reporting from heavier workload-specific Power BI models toward a shared analytics foundation with conformed facts, shared dimensions, pre-built aggregations, and common definitions across conversations, sessions, agents, queues, channels, CSAT, handle time, and operational KPIs. Customers can continue using out-of-box Power BI reports while gaining extensibility through Fabric, Direct Lake, SQL, Spark, and custom lakehouse models.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Reroute conversations to the right queue automatically
items.desc: Service representatives can reroute a live voice or messaging conversation when they realize they aren't the right person to help. The representative updates the conversation details, or the details of a linked case, contact, or account, and then selects Reroute. The conversation goes back through classification and route-to-queue rules and is assigned to the right queue automatically, so representatives don't need to know routing rules or choose a queue themselves. The customer stays connected throughout, and the next representative receives the conversation with its full history and updated context. Admins choose whether to turn on Reroute…

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Use bullseye routing with user groups to orchestrate conversations
items.desc:
Bullseye routing with user groups enables a tiered assignment strategy that automatically expands the pool of eligible representatives as conversation wait time increases. Rather than assigning from a fixed pool or waiting for overflow rules to trigger, this approach progressively widens availability in concentric rings—starting with the best-fit representatives and expanding outward as needed.
Administrators configure this scenario by associating user groups with a queue and defining wait time thresholds for each tier. For example:
0–30 seconds: Assign to Tier 1 specialists (primary user group)
30–60 seconds: Expand to include Tier 2…
items.when: GA: October CY2026 · Preview: July CY2026

items.title: Announcing: Migrate Azure Container Apps logging destination from Log Analytics to Azure Monitor
items.desc:
The Log Analytics logging destination for Azure Container Apps is now a legacy logging option. Existing environments configured with the Log Analytics logging destination will continue to function normally. However, we recommend planning a migration to the Azure Monitor logging destination.   
This recommendation is driven by the underlying HTTP Data Collector API used by the Log Analytics logging destination. Support for the legacy HTTP Data Collector API ended on September 14, 2026 and will now only be receiving critical security updates.  
Recommended action  
Review any monitoring resources that depend on logs collected through the Log…

items.title: Public Preview: Cross Tenant Restore with Azure Backup
items.desc:
Cross-Tenant Restore (CTR) helps organizations establish an independent recovery path by enabling Azure VM backups to be restored into a separate Azure tenant. It strengthens cyber resilience while using the existing backup copy, without requiring customers to maintain and manage duplicate backup data.
Learn more.

items.title: Generally Available: Marketplace private offer enhancements
items.desc: Private offers through Microsoft Marketplace help you optimize your spending power with pricing and terms aligned to your organization’s needs, including flexible billing, custom contract lengths, and more. For eligible private offers, we are simplifying the private offer purchase experience for customers. Previously, customers needed to first “accept” the private offer and then “purchase” individual products. Now, customers simply purchase all included products with one easy step for eligible private offers. Purchase governance remains aligned with Azure role-based access controls through the billing admin role. This is currently being…

items.title: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on Microsoft Copilot Harness
items.desc: Enable Microsoft Copilot Studio agents to browse and interact with websites as a native capability powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness. Using natural-language instructions, agents can navigate web pages, extract information, and download files. Agents can then use that information and those files alongside other tools to complete end-to-end workflows, extending their reach beyond configured knowledge sources and API-based integrations.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: November CY2026

items.title: OneDrive: Updated placement of the Create or upload button for Web
items.desc:
OneDrive for the web is updating the placement of the Create or upload button to provide a more consistent file experience across OneDrive and SharePoint. The button will move from the left navigation pane to the right side of the page, bringing familiar navigation from SharePoint document libraries to OneDrive.
The available options for creating files and folders or uploading content will remain unchanged.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
items.desc: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization on Teams Pro Management portal
items.desc: Teams admins can access utilization analytics for Teams bookable desks on Teams Pro Management portal, similar to analytics provided for meeting rooms on the portal today. For utilization analytics to be enabled, a desk needs to have one or more peripheral device associated, and the desk needs to be licensed with Teams Shared Space license or Teams Shared Space - Single Space license.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
items.desc: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.
items.when: GA: October CY2026 · Preview: September CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
items.desc: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
items.desc: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to files stored in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData. This helps improve coverage by detecting and protecting sensitive data in these locations.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Usage reports - Message consumption for Pay-as-you-go experiences in Copilot Chat.
items.desc: A new report to help IT admins manage costs for billed messages that are Pay-as-you-go enabled for Copilot Chat. Reporting includes drill down of billed messages per user, per billing policy, per agent-level and agent-user level pair. #copilotcontrolsystem
items.when: GA: April CY2027 · Preview: May CY2025

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance - Enhanced Policy Conditions
items.desc: Three updates are coming to enhance policy conditions. First, our updated policy conditions enable the detection of messages sent and received both to and from external email addresses, allowing you to identify specific instances of information being shared with external contacts. Secondly, with the new OR condition capability, you can combine multiple conditions within the same policy, creating custom logic to suit your unique compliance requirements. Lastly, to make policy creation and updates a seamless process, we've introduced the ability to test conditions before implementing them. By using sample messages, you can evaluate how your…

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Improve rental operations and fulfillment
items.desc: As organizations expand beyond one-time asset sales to rental, leasing, and servitization business models, new rental management capabilities help them manage and monetize the assets they build, own, and operate throughout the rental lifecycle. In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, organizations can manage availability and reservations, fulfillment, delivery and pickup, inspections, and returns. These capabilities can help improve fleet utilization, reduce idle time, and streamline the movement of fleet items between locations, jobsites, and customers. Together, connected rental processes across supply chain, service, and finance can help…

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in DoD
items.desc: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to the Microsoft 365 Department of Defense (DoD) environment, providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the DoD environment.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot app mode handoffs
items.desc: The Chat experience in the Copilot app will suggest a better-fit mode based on the user's prompt, if applicable. For example, it will suggest Cowork or other supported modes as they become available. Users will see a suggestion card after they send a prompt in Chat, with an explanation of the better-fit mode and an option for the user to switch to the suggested mode. Their chat conversation will be attached to the prompt in the new mode to maintain context.

items.title: Power Pages: Track Power Pages performance and usage with monitor hub
items.desc:
Power Pages is integrated into the monitor hub. This integration empowers site owners, makers, and administrators to access performance and usage insights directly within the monitor hub of the Power Platform admin center.
Metrics available
The following metrics will be surfaced in monitor hub:
• Session count: Tracks the number of sessions.
• Session duration: Measures the average time spent in a session.
• Page load time: Captures the time it takes for a web page to fully load (P75).
• Error rate: Measures the percentage of requests where pages become unresponsive or return component-level errors.

items.title: Power Automate: AI-assisted UI Automation repair
items.desc: A new agentic debug run feature will be available in the flow designer. The UI automation repair interface launches while the flow is running, validating each selector used in the flow. It then proposes a new selector in case an existing one does not work as expected, after the user captures the respective element for reference.
items.when: GA: March CY2027 · Preview: July CY2026

items.title: Generally Available: Higher limit of Azure Blob Storage accounts per region per subscription
items.desc:
Higher Azure Storage account resource quotas are now generally available, supporting up to 1,000 storage accounts with standard endpoints per region, per subscription, up from the default of 250. Manage more accounts in a single subscription, reducing the need to distribute resources across multiple subscriptions. 
Request quota increases through the Azure Portal, Azure CLI, or Azure PowerShell without opening a support ticket. Azure Storage Resource Provider (SRP) API read, write, and list operations automatically scale to support higher approved account quotas.

items.title: Generally Available: Cost management and tagging for Claude models in Microsoft Foundry
items.desc: Microsoft Foundry now brings Claude models into Azure Cost Management alongside the rest of your Foundry spend, generally available. Until now, Claude charges appeared under SaaS rather than under the Foundry resource used to deploy them, and Claude deployments lacked the tags enterprises rely on for showback and chargeback, leaving finance and platform teams to reconcile costs by hand. With this release, Claude costs appear under the associated Foundry resource; Claude deployments and Foundry resources support tags that follow your organization's existing conventions; and Claude cost records carry model and usage_type tags, so you can…

items.desc:
Announcing the general availability of profile and route
level policies for Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) on Azure Front Door
Premium. WAF policies are no longer limited to individual domains: you can now
apply broad baseline protection across an entire Azure Front Door profile and
use targeted policies for the routes that need different controls.

across every domain in a profile, then apply a route level policy to sensitive

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Workflow to automatically add tag members to relevant channels
items.desc: Associate channels with a tag so members are automatically added to those channels when they join the tag. This helps teams keep channel membership in sync with evolving groups, reduces manual management, and ensures members have access to the conversations and content most relevant to their role.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes in messages
items.desc: Microsoft Teams will introduce near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes shared in messages. By analyzing destinations embedded in QR codes, Teams can identify potential phishing and fraud threats and apply additional protections to malicious content, extending existing URL protection to QR-based attacks.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
items.desc: The Unified Classification Management Experience unifies every classifier in Microsoft Purview—Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into one place to discover, create, validate, and manage classifiers.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: October CY2026

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.desc: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
items.desc: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

items.title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Outlook mobile apps
items.desc: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

items.title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Mac
items.desc: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

items.title: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook for Mac
items.desc: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on Mac devices.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with list form in Workflows
items.desc: Starts a workflow with a form to collect the information you need to run the rest of your workflow.

items.title: OneDrive: Manage access to the OneDrive Photos Desktop experience
items.desc: OneDrive is adding administrative controls for the Photos experience on Windows. Organizations can manage whether users sign in with personal Microsoft accounts. These controls help IT teams align OneDrive Photos with their access, data governance, and device-management requirements.

items.title: Outlook: Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachment for iOS and Android
items.desc: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview sensitivity label inheritance from attachments. When users attach files with sensitivity labels, Outlook can automatically apply or recommend an email sensitivity label based on organizational policy settings. This helps organizations maintain consistent data classification and protection while reducing manual labeling effort.

items.title: Outlook: Microsoft Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachments
items.desc: When composing an email in Outlook for Mac, Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels can be automatically applied or recommended based on the sensitivity labels of attached files. This helps users consistently protect sensitive information, reduces manual labeling effort, and supports organizational compliance requirements by aligning email protection with the sensitivity of attached content.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.desc: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents
items.desc: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.

items.title: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
items.desc: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Search Helps You Discover People
items.desc: Now Copilot Search can return matching people for your broader people search queries. Allowing you to discover, disambiguate, and explore known and new people to contact. Discover Whether you're looking for people with a specific skill like "Project leadership" or "Artificial Intelligence" Copilot Search can help you explore potential contacts through the People data source. Disambiguate When there are multiple people matching in exact name, email, or alias Copilot Search will help you disambiguate through a new carousel on the main results page alongside other relevant results.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Suggested References in Copilot Notebooks
items.desc: Users can now quickly enrich their Copilot Notebook with relevant Suggested References based on recent user work activity. Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft 365: PAYGO consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
items.desc: Use the new PAYGO consumption-based meter to pay for your extra SharePoint storage needs. This reduces the operational overhead associated with purchasing extra storage packs and more seamlessly integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: June CY2026

items.title: PowerPoint: Clear view-only messaging
items.desc: When you open a presentation you don't have permission to edit, PowerPoint now shows a clear "Viewing Only" message bar. It explains that the file is view-only, shows who created it, and tells you to contact the owner if you need more access.

items.title: Outlook: Multiple Intune Accounts in Outlook for Android
items.desc: Multiple MAM (Mobile Application Management) Intune Accounts will now be supported in Outlook for Android. Only one MDM (Mobile Device Management) account will be supported at a time per device.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Boost contact center efficiency with real-time streaming analytics
items.desc:
Real-time streaming analytics is built into the new supervisor application. An advanced streaming engine keeps metrics up to date with near-instant updates, allowing supervisors to view the latest data without refreshing the dashboard.
Key capabilities include:
Continuous, streaming dashboards: Monitor mission-critical KPIs such as queue backlog, service level, abandon rate, and representative presence in near real time. Visual alerts highlight anomalies as they occur.
Full-screen wallboards: Display live metrics on high-resolution monitors across the contact center floor, providing teams with a shared, at-a-glance view of…

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint Site Builder
items.desc: This feature enables users to easily create new SharePoint sites with Copilot. Users can review and confirm a clear site plan before Copilot builds the site.
items.when: GA: December CY2026 · Preview: October CY2026

items.title: Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
items.desc: Edit with Copilot makes it easier to edit and transform your Excel workbooks on your phone using natural language. Copilot can continue working on your task even when you move away from the app, so you can come back when the work is ready. Chat mode also remains available when you want to ask questions and get insights without making changes to your workbook.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks
items.desc: App Blocks enables M365 Copilot Chat users to turn their requests and data into rich, interactive experiences directly within the conversation, including calculators, dashboards, forms, planners, visualizations, simulations, comparison tools, and other interactive apps. It helps users move beyond static responses to explore data, adjust inputs, visualize outcomes, and simulate workflows in place, while supporting grounded scenarios where current information can be retrieved and then rendered into an interactive experience.

items.title: Excel: Get and transform data with Copilot in Excel
items.desc: Get your data ready, just by asking. Describe the data you need and how you want it prepared, and the new get data skill handles the rest. It can connect and transform your data, then load the results into your workbook using Power Query, giving you a query you can inspect, edit, and refresh without having to build it yourself. Depending on the data source, authentication may be required.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Optimized Customer data entities
items.desc:
Dynamics 365 Finance introduces a set of optimized customer data entities that provide more focused options for integrating customer information. Instead of relying on a single broad customer entity, organizations can work with purpose-specific entities for core customer information, extended customer attributes, postal addresses, electronic contact information, and customer associations.
The optimized entities support both Data management import/export and OData integration scenarios, enabling organizations to build customer integrations around the specific data required for each business process.
items.when: GA: July CY2027 · Preview: October CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Expand localization in LATAM countries for Argentina
items.desc:

items.title: Power Pages: First Class Support for Connector APIs in Power Pages

items.title: SharePoint: AI input widget and content preview in Copilot
items.desc: With this new capability, users of Copilot in SharePoint will be able to view saved and unsaved preview content side by side with chat. Users will also be able to interact with created HTML forms and confirm responses to send to chat.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation

items.desc: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel helps users make complex changes with confidence by outlining a clear, step by step approach before anything in the workbook is updated. items.desc: Use Copilot to see a summary of the latest comments and changes made to your Word files using the Copilot chat pane.

items.title: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
items.desc: We're now introducing the third generation of the Microsoft 365 sharing experience designed to make collaboration simpler, smarter, and more secure by default. items.title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
items.desc: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

items.desc: This update introduces a co-branding experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app that helps organizations present an admin approved visual identifier directly within the Chat screen. Makers will be presented with recommendations and supporting evidence, expected impact, and the related instruction and tool changes. items.desc: Excel Agent helps you turn data into clear charts, summaries, and insights using built‑in formulas and logic. items.title: Planner: Expiration of plans from meetings due to inactivity
items.desc: Planner plans created from Teams meetings (via Meeting Notes or Loop) often remain unused long after the meeting ends. These inactive plans accumulate and clutter over time. Only the Planner plan is removed whereas the tasks in Loop and meeting notes stay intact.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint

items.desc:

With this update, organizations can begin using Brand Center while deferring Public CDN until they need capabilities that depend on it, such as organizational fonts.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
items.desc: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Add references to your Copilot Notebooks from the Quick Access section in Search on the M365 Copilot app

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Preview Chat and History
items.desc: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage as well as all every historical run. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Agent Evaluations
items.desc: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly associated with their evaluations, including a breakdown of usage for eval generation, test runs and model grading/judgement. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage transparent throughout the development lifecycle.

items.title: OneDrive: Exclude specific folders from syncing
items.desc: OneDrive for Windows and Mac will let users exclude specific folders from syncing, so folders that do not belong in the cloud, such as developer tooling folders like PowerShell modules, Visual Studio configuration, and node modules, stay local on the device instead of uploading to OneDrive. Administrators can define folder exclusion rules for their organization.

items.title: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in the OneDrive apps (iOS and Android)
items.desc: The Microsoft OneDrive apps for iOS and Android will let users annotate PDFs protected by a Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity label that applies encryption — without removing or weakening the label. Users with edit/annotate rights can add a full set of annotations — including ink, highlight, free text, notes, signatures, image/shape/date stamps, bookmarks, and form fields — directly in the OneDrive mobile PDF viewer; the file's encryption and usage rights are preserved end to end. items.title: Access: Zooming for Continuous Forms and Multiple-Items Forms
items.desc: Access extends zoom capabilities to continuous forms and pop-up forms, building on zoom support already available in tables and queries. items.desc: Access will add magnification slider (10% to 500%) in lower right of the application, similar to the feature in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. It will also be keyboard accessible and available on the ribbon in Access forms, tables, and queries.

items.title: Word: Copilot edit mode is available to users in Office 365 GCC
items.desc: Edit with Copilot in Word is now available to users in Office 365 GCC, enabling government customers to work with Copilot as a co-creator directly in your document to create, refine, and transform documents more efficiently.

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
items.desc: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Teams Channel Backup
items.desc: A backup and recovery feature that lets you recover team & channel data (like files, messages exchanged over channels) in Microsoft Teams to a previously known good state after accidental changes or security compromises. Supported items include Team, Channels (Standard, Private, Public) and underlying data. Retention period supported is 30 days.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): AI Generated video drafts include text animations and new layout options
items.desc: Users will find updated layouts and text animations on video projects generated with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Upgraded music selection for Copilot AI Videos
items.desc: With a Microsoft365 Copilot license, Copilot AI-generated video projects have improved audio with realistic AI voiceover, professional sound effects, and enhanced audio mixing.

items.desc: Clipchamp Editor will support simple animations for text layers. items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Videos in the Clipchamp Start Page
items.desc: Users can use Copilot to create videos directly from the Clipchamp Start page. Turn a simple prompt or existing document into a polished video in minutes. Copilot will automatically draft a script, selects visuals, add narration, and assembles the video for you—no video editing experience required. Review, refine, and export your video quickly, all in one flow.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Entra ID Backup & Recovery
items.desc: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs. This capability allows customers and ISV apps to do a point in time restore of Entra objects to a last known good state to a rolling historical 30-day point. Advanced recovery features are currently limited to the Entra admin portal, but some user recovery actions will be possible via the M365 Backup native app UX in the M365 Admin center. Note that the existing 7-day recovery that comes with a customer's P1 & P2 licenses is already generally available and is independent of this roadmap item.

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
items.desc: The updated identity timeline provides security teams with a single chronological view of activity and alerts associated with an identity and its linked accounts. It normalizes activity from integrated Microsoft security products, including Microsoft Entra sign-ins, Microsoft Graph audit events, SaaS and cloud activity, and device logons.
